ios.desc:
Your money should not sit still waiting for you to spend it.

Coinage keeps your cash in diversified index funds and gets it back to you when you need it. You stay invested longer without locking anything up.

HOW IT WORKS

Pick a Nest. Nests are curated baskets of index funds. Choose one that fits your timeline and how much risk you want. Fund it in a few taps.

Set your rules. Decide what triggers a sell and how much. Coinage follows the rules you wrote, not a feeling you had on a Tuesday.

Watch it run. See what you spend, what stays invested, and how the two line up.

FREE
Open an account, build a Nest, move money in and out on your own.

PREMIUM
Automated selling, rule-based sells, spending tracking, and advanced analytics.

Money should never be the bottleneck to human experience.
